title: Travel stickers on a suitcase
slide_intent: Let a flexible set of small expressions accumulate because personal objects can carry several encounters with a brand at once.
strategic_value: Multilingual stickers and Duo can connect Duolingo to the personal experience of travel.
demonstration: A silver suitcase against green carries word stickers, a flag, a helmeted Duo and a Duolingo wordmark beneath its black handle.
practical_value: Compare how individual stickers remain recognizable when mixed on an irregular object.

content_islands.name: Suitcase
content_islands.spec: Keep the silver case and extended black handle against the green field.

content_islands.name: Sticker cluster
content_islands.spec: Scatter multilingual green-and-white phrases, flag, Duo and wordmark across the visible case.

reference_purposes.Application: The artwork shows a sticker family placed together on luggage.
reference_purposes.Expression: Multilingual phrases and character graphics extend the identity as separate small pieces.
